summary: Re-verified CORS lockdown. Backend code is correctly locked down (verified via localhost:8001). However, tests still fail when hitting the preview URL because the Emergent preview edge (Cloudflare/K8s ingress) rewrites CORS headers to 'access-control-allow-origin: *' regardless of what backend returns. Health endpoint returns exactly {"status":"ok"}.

minor.issue: Cloudflare/ingress in front of preview.emergentagent.com overrides backend CORS headers with 'access-control-allow-origin: *' and 'access-control-allow-credentials: true' (spec-invalid combo). Backend itself is correctly locked down.

action_items: No backend code change needed — CORS lockdown works correctly when hitting the FastAPI app directly (verified via localhost:8001).

Option A: Update the two failing CORS tests to hit http://localhost:8001 instead of REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, since the preview edge proxy strips/replaces CORS headers and does not reflect real production behavior.
Option B: Document that CORS enforcement is only verifiable in the production deployment (buildingmyawesomelifedaily.com), not the preview URL.
In production, ensure Vercel/Cloud Run/etc. does NOT add its own permissive CORS headers on top of FastAPI's (otherwise same override issue will recur).
critical_code_review_comments: CORS middleware in /app/backend/server.py (lines 599-609) is correctly implemented: env-driven allow_origins with defensive '*' strip and allow_credentials=True. Verified against localhost — evil.com gets 400 with no ACAO; buildingmyawesomelifedaily.com gets 200 with proper ACAO reflecting the exact origin.

success_rate.backend: backend-code: 100% (localhost); via-preview-edge: 0% for CORS tests due to ingress override

context_for_next_testing_agent: The 2 CORS pytest tests hit REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (preview URL) which is fronted by Cloudflare that rewrites CORS to 'ACAO: *'. Backend CORS itself is correct — verified by curl to http://localhost:8001. GET /api/health returns exactly {"status":"ok"} (regression passes). If retesting CORS, either point tests at localhost:8001 or verify against real prod domain.
rca of the issue: Root cause: Emergent preview environment sits behind a Cloudflare/ingress layer that injects its own CORS response headers ('access-control-allow-origin: *', 'access-control-allow-headers: *', extra methods HEAD/PATCH, server: cloudflare) — these override the correct headers FastAPI returns. Evidence: (a) curl to http://localhost:8001/api/health with Origin=https://evil.com → NO access-control-allow-origin header (correct); (b) curl to http://localhost:8001/api/health with Origin=https://buildingmyawesomelifedaily.com → 'access-control-allow-origin: https://buildingmyawesomelifedaily.com' (correct, exact reflection); (c) same requests via https://mindful-focus-30.preview.emergentagent.com always return 'access-control-allow-origin: *' with 'server: cloudflare'. Mitigation: point CORS-specific pytest at localhost or exempt CORS tests from preview URL; no backend code fix required.
